==Chinese==

===Glyph origin===
One of the 324 simplified characters introduced by the {{w|Republic of China}} ({{w|Kuomintang}} government) in 1935 as a simplified form of {{l|zh|鬨}} but was later retracted in 1936. <!-- Refer https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ROC24_SC3.jpg -->

This character is obsolete in modern use. In the 1956 first round revision table of variant Chinese characters ({{lw|zh|第一批异体字整理表}}) by the People's Republic of China, {{l|zh|鬨}} and {{l|zh|閧}} were listed as {{w|Variant Chinese characters|variant forms}} that were replaced by {{l|zh|哄}} as the orthodox form. <!-- Refer https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/第一批异体字整理表/1955年 -->
